abstract: We determine the exact Tur\'an density of the $3$-uniform zycle $Z_\ell$ for every even integer $\ell\ge 4$ with $3\nmid\ell$, showing that $\pi(Z_\ell)=5/9$. More generally, we prove that $\pi(Z_\ell)\le 5/9$ for all even $\ell\ge 4$. In the range of equality, we also establish a stability theorem, showing that every almost extremal $Z_\ell$-free $3$-graph is close in edit distance to the classical Tur\'an construction.
hook: The Turán density of even 3-uniform zycles is 5/9 whenever the cycle length is not divisible by 3.
summary: Turán density asks how many triples a 3-uniform hypergraph can hold without containing a given forbidden structure. The author proves the answer is exactly 5/9 for even zycle lengths not divisible by 3, bounds it by 5/9 for all even lengths, and shows near-extremal examples resemble the classic construction. The exact value is not settled for lengths divisible by 3.
title: Exact Tur\'an densities of even zycles
